comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper stop versus rotate a window sash upright while retracting two spring latches until they engage.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses independent tools on concentric threaded parts; the window task uses bilateral latch depression while lifting a large hinged sash evenly.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained stop angle across cycles; the window task requires pivot retention, near-upright alignment, both latch bolts extended into slots, and stillness.
comparison.reason: Both finish with a retained articulated state, but bilateral latch management during a large-object lift tests a meaningfully different physical ability.
